title_sq: Shitet kat pallati i pershtatur Hotel ne Qender te Tiranes, rruga e Kavajes (ID 4101872)

Shitet 1 100 000 euro
title_en: For sale on the floor of the hotel building in the center of Tirana, Kavaje street (ID 4101872)
description_en: In the center of Tirana, Kavaje street, an apartment for sale, suitable for a hotel, surface area 310 m², the 9th floor, not the last, of a well-managed new building, a dedicated elevator for the hotel floor, fully invested, parquet flooring, air conditioning in every room. Has regular mortgage documentation. It is organized in: 7 bedrooms (of which, 3 double rooms, 2 single rooms, 2 studios), 2 balconies, 8 toilets, 1 staff room, 2 small warehouses, distribution corridor. Business established for years with average monthly turnover ranging from 6000-8000 euros. Very good investment opportunity, perfect positioning. It is currently rented for 3850 euros net.
